newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT Tieto up sharply in active demand.
newsitem.headline: TT Tieto up sharply in active demand.

text.p: Shares in Finnish software and data services group TT Tieto Oy rose sharply on Monday with foreign demand apparently driving up prices on a market almost devoid of sellers, brokers said.
At 1430/1130 GMT TT Tieto traded at 470.00 markka, up 32.00 markka or more than seven percent, and and within striking distance of its May 15 all-time high of 471.00.
Trade in the share was unusually lively, with volume rising to 20 million markka, with a few 10,000-share blocks crossed inhouse at Merita accounting for almost half the volume.
"TT Tieto is usually so illiquid that if one big buyer comes along, the share goes up," one broker said.
Others said TT Tieto was mirroring strength in Swedish data group VM Data, but that there was no concrete connection between the two shares' gains.
Gains in TT Tieto accounted for 1.5 points of a FOX index gain of 14 points, to 1,176.05.
